mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially increasing ranolazine levels through reduced clearance; ranolazine is renally cleared and metabolized hepatically via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly during concurrent use; adjust ranolazine dose if significant renal impairment develops; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
